findings.one_line: The advertised interval cannot be evaluated as stated because its radius uses existential constants C_B, C_S, and C_G with no numerical calibration or finite procedure for obtaining them; lift explicit conservative constants or a calibration algorithm into the definition.

The full-class interval likewise depends on an unspecified approximation constant C_app (and hence C_b and C_v), so its claimed explicit honest interval needs an evaluable calibration rather than proof-only constants.

Position the finite-sample CATE interval against the closest general valid-DP-CI framework (e.g. Covington, He, Honaker, and Kamath 2021) as well as the listed mean/median and causal papers; state precisely why its bootstrap-based scope does not deliver this uniform Hölder pointwise result.
